blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Evaluating text generation requires measuring how well the generated distribution matches the data distribution.
For autoregressive models, this is done by the perplexity.
Diffusion and flow-based language models can only provide a likelihood bound, whose tightness differs between model families.
Sample-based substitutes such as generative perplexity with entropy
do not consider the distribution fit.
We propose SOL,
a distance between text distributions.
Each sequence is represented by the empirical measure of its hidden states under a fixed transformer and the distributions of these measures are compared by the double sliced Wasserstein distance. We prove that SOL is a metric if the transformer is injective.
Experiments show that SOL detects distributional failures, recovers expected model trends, and provides stable sample-based estimates.
We put forward SOL to fill the gap in the current evaluation protocol used for non-autoregressive models. As a first step we use SOL to re-evaluate a variety of models trained on OpenWebText.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models based on autoregressive decoding are the prevailing
approach to text generation. Recently, diffusion and flow-based models, which
generate the whole sequence iteratively by reversing a noising process, have
become a serious alternative. Discrete diffusion models corrupt tokens by masking
or uniform replacement ( Austin et al., 2021 ; Lou et al., 2024 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Sahoo et al., 2025 ) , while continuous models embed tokens into a
continuous space and define the noise process there ( Li et al., 2022 ; Dieleman et al., 2022 ; Gulrajani and Hashimoto, 2023 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Chemseddine et al., 2026 ) .
This raises the question of how well the generated distribution p gen p_{\mathrm{gen}} matches the data distribution p data p_{\mathrm{data}} .

文本生成方法。 最近,传播和流动模式
通过反转点名过程, 迭代生成整个序列, 有

(Austin等人,2021年;Lou等人,2024年;Sahoo等人,2024年;Sahoo等人,2025年),而连续的模型将符号嵌入a
持续空间和界定那里的噪音过程(Li等,2022;Dieleman等,2022;Gulrajani和Hashimoto,2023;Hu等,2026;Chen等,2026;Chemseddine等,2026)。
这引起了一个问题,即生成的分布 p gen p_{\mathrm{ gen} 与数据分布 p_{\mathrm{ data} 的匹配程度如何 。

blocks.en:
For autoregressive models, the standard answer is the perplexity of held-out data, which is computed from the exact likelihood p θ p_{\theta} .
For diffusion models, the likelihood is intractable.
Instead, an upper bound of the perplexity is reported, based on an evidence lower bound (ELBO).
This causes two problems.
First, an ELBO is often not available.
For continuous models, the bound holds only in expectation over the noise, requires the change-of-variables formula along the flow and has only been derived for selected models ( Gulrajani and Hashimoto, 2023 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
Moreover, most recent models use self-conditioning, where the network receives its own previous prediction as input.
This input arises along the sampling trajectory and cannot be recovered for a given data sequence.
Second, even when an ELBO exists, it is not comparable across model families. Sahoo et al. (2026) observe that perplexity ranks models correctly within one family of diffusion models but not between families.
The reason is that the gap between ELBO and likelihood is a property of the noise process and its parameterization, not of the model alone.
For masked diffusion, the bound is tight ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) , whereas for uniform diffusion it is looser and not even optimized by the training objective ( Gourevitch et al., 2026 ) .
A better perplexity may thus reflect a tighter bound rather than a better model.

相反,根据较低的约束(ELBO)证据,报告一个复杂度的上限。
这造成了两个问题。

因此,更复杂的问题可能反映更严格的约束,而不是更好的模式。

blocks.en:
Since every model can be sampled, the generative perplexity (Gen. PPL) together with the token entropy has become the common substitute ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Franca and Tong, 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Chemseddine et al., 2026 ) .
Here, Gen. PPL is the perplexity of the generated texts under a fixed reference model such as GPT-2 Large,
and the entropy is computed from token frequencies within sequences.
Since both are averaged over sequences, they do not reward variety in generated outputs, see Figure 4 for an example of mode collapse.
Moreover, Gen. PPL measures agreement with the reference model and not with p data p_{\text{data}} . Hence, it rewards imitation of the reference model instead of actual data.
In short, neither quantity measures the distance between p gen p_{\text{gen}} and p data p_{\text{data}} .

blocks.en:
For image generation, the dominant evaluation method is FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) .
It maps samples of both distributions into the feature space of a fixed network and compares the two feature distributions there.
We therefore seek an analogous score for text distributions that (1) requires only samples from p gen p_{\text{gen}} and p data p_{\text{data}} , (2) is a distance, i.e., it is zero if and only if the two distributions agree, (3) reflects both the quality of the generated texts and their coverage of p data p_{\text{data}} , (4) has an estimator which is stable in the number of samples, and (5) is cheap to compute. The most popular alternative to Gen. PPL is MAUVE ( Pillutla et al., 2021 ; Pillutla et al., 2023 ) . It embeds each text by a single
latent representation, quantizes both samples by K K -means clustering, and
compares the resulting histograms through a KL-divergence frontier. However,
MAUVE is not a distance, its value depends on the number of samples and
clusters, and its behavior depends strongly on the chosen representation. The
standard last hidden state of a causal transformer is insensitive to changes
near the beginning of a sequence ( He et al., 2023 ) , while mean pooling
can map distinct token clouds to the same representation ( Hara et al., 2026 ) .

We propose SOL, a sample-based distance between text distributions, by representing each text as an empirical distribution of contextual token states and comparing the resulting distributions with the double sliced Wasserstein distance. estimator, and correlates better with the evaluated human rankings than MAUVE
(Table 2 ). 3. We use SOL to evaluate a broad range of autoregressive, discrete and continuous diffusion language models on OpenWebText (Table 24 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Euclidean Latent Space Methods

blocks.en: Standard methods for comparing language distributions, such as MAUVE ( Pillutla et al., 2021 ) and BERT-FID ( Alihosseini et al., 2019 ) , rely on a single latent token representation obtained from the final hidden layer of a transformer. Alternatively, the hidden states across positions can be aggregated by mean pooling. We briefly introduce both representations before turning to MAUVE.
blocks.zh: 比较语言分布的标准方法,如MAUVE(Pillutla等,2021年)和BERT-FID(Alihosseini等,2019年),依赖于从变压器最后隐藏层得到的单一潜在符号表示. 或者,各职位之间的隐藏状态可以通过平均集合加以汇总。 我们先简短地介绍一下这两份陈述,然后再谈MAUVE。

MAUVE ( Pillutla et al., 2021 ; Pillutla et al., 2023 ) is a sample-based score for comparing generated and reference text distributions. It embeds each text by a single latent representation, jointly quantizes both samples using k k -means, and represents them by the resulting empirical cluster frequencies. MAUVE then summarizes the trade-off between KL ( p ~ gen ∥ r ~ λ ) \operatorname{KL}(\tilde{p}_{\mathrm{gen}}\|\tilde{r}_{\lambda}) and KL ( p ~ data ∥ r ~ λ ) \operatorname{KL}(\tilde{p}_{\mathrm{data}}\|\tilde{r}_{\lambda}) ,

by the area under their so-called divergence frontier, see Appendix B.1 for a detailed algorithmic description.

blocks.en:
The method has two drawbacks relevant to our goal. First, MAUVE is sensitive to the finite-sample quantization and can be unstable with respect to both the number of samples and clusters, see Figure 2 . Second, its behavior depends strongly on the chosen text representation.
In particular, MAUVE based on the last hidden state of a causal transformer is insensitive to perturbations at the beginning or middle of a sequence ( He et al., 2023 ) , which we reproduce in Figure 3 . Mean pooling alleviates this particular problem, but the resulting score saturates at low corruption levels, see Appendix E.2.1 .

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation of Language Models by Wasserstein Distances
blocks.zh: 4 Wasserstein远程对语言模型的评价

blocks.en:
We represent each sequence by the empirical measure of its hidden states. This
turns a text distribution into a distribution over measures in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} .
Direct optimal transport between these distributions leads to an expensive
Wasserstein-on-Wasserstein problem ( Piening and Beinert, 2026b ) . We therefore
introduce the sliced Wasserstein construction underlying double slicing and
then define SOL in Section 4.3 , where we show that it
satisfies the requirements (1)–(5) from the introduction.

我们用其隐藏状态的经验度量来代表每个序列。 这个
将文本分布转换为 R d\ mathb{ R}^{d} 中的度量衡分布 。
这些分布之间的直接最佳运输导致昂贵
Wasserstein-on-Wasserstein问题(皮宁和贝纳特,2026b. 因此,我们

blocks.en:
A text distribution p data ∈ 𝒫 ⁡ ( 𝒱 ≤ L ) p_{\mathrm{data}}\in\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{V}^{\leq L}) is a distribution over token
sequences. The canonical lift 𝐱 ↦ δ 𝐱 \mathbf{x}\mapsto\delta_{\mathbf{x}} would represent each sequence as a Dirac
measure, but 𝒱 ≤ L \mathcal{V}^{\leq L} has no natural semantic ground metric.
Instead, we propose to use the learned causal transformer 𝐇 θ \mathbf{H}^{\theta} , and introduce the associated token-cloud distribution by T θ : 𝒱 ≤ L → 𝒫 2 ​ ( ℝ d ) , 𝐱 ↦ 1 | 𝐱 | ​ ∑ l = 1 | 𝐱 | δ h 𝐱 ≤ l θ . \displaystyle T^{\theta}:\mathcal{V}^{\leq L}\rightarrow\mathcal{P}_{2}(\mathbb{R}^{d}),\qquad\mathbf{x}\mapsto\frac{1}{|\mathbf{x}|}\sum_{l=1}^{|\mathbf{x}|}\delta_{h^{\theta}_{\mathbf{x}\leq l}}. (6) This allows us to push forward p data ∈ 𝒫 ⁡ ( 𝒱 ≤ L ) p_{\mathrm{data}}\in\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{V}^{\leq L}) to T # θ ​ p data ∈ 𝒫 2 ​ ( 𝒫 2 ​ ( ℝ d ) ) T^{\theta}_{\#}p_{\mathrm{data}}\in\mathcal{P}_{2}(\mathcal{P}_{2}(\mathbb{R}^{d})) . This representation has two advantages. First, it compares sequences 𝐱 1 \mathbf{x}_{1} and 𝐱 2 \mathbf{x}_{2} of different lengths, | 𝐱 1 | ≠ | 𝐱 2 | |\mathbf{x}_{1}|\neq|\mathbf{x}_{2}| . Second, it allows reordered sentences such as ‘ cat on a mat ’ and ‘ mat under a cat ’ to remain close without imposing an artificial ordering. As shown in Section A.1 , the map remains injective due to the injectivity of the last hidden-state representation, where token representations encode their context. For a bidirectional encoder, we replace h 𝐱 ≤ l θ h^{\theta}_{\mathbf{x}\leq l} by h 𝐱 , l θ , bi h^{\theta,\mathrm{bi}}_{\mathbf{x},l} .

blocks.en: 5 Numerical Experiments

blocks.en: We evaluate SOL on small- to medium-scale language models, with a particular focus on diffusion-based generation. Following Pillutla et al. (2021) , we first test whether SOL reflects expected changes in generation quality, including sequence length, decoding strategy, and model size. We then study the numerical stability and sample efficiency of the estimator. Finally, we evaluate SOL on failure cases of existing metrics, in particular MAUVE, and use it to compare autoregressive, discrete-diffusion, and continuous-diffusion language models on OpenWebText. A detailed comparison with MAUVE is given in Section E.2.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价中小型语言模型的SOL,特别侧重于以传播为基础的生成。 继Pillutla等人(2021年)之后,我们首先测试SOL是否反映了生成质量的预期变化,包括序列长度,解码策略,和模型大小. 然后我们研究估算器的数值稳定性和样本效率。 最后,我们评价现有度量衡,特别是MAUVE的故障案例的SOL,并用它来比较OpenWebText上的自递式,离散分流和相继分流的语言模型. E.2.3.节详细比较了MAUVE。

blocks.en: Generation length and model size. Increasing the generation length of GPT-2 degrades the generated text, and SOL reflects this deterioration, see Figure 5 (left). The same experiment also recovers the expected ordering across model sizes, from GPT-2 XL to GPT-2 Small.

blocks.en: Mode collapse and support expansion. Following Bronnec et al. (2024) , we evaluate SOL under mode collapse and support expansion on AG News ( Zhang et al., 2015 ) . Starting from a mixture of WORLD and SPORTS articles ( Q 2 Q_{2} ), we progressively remove SPORTS articles ( Q 1 Q_{1} ) or add articles from two additional topics ( Q 3 Q_{3} ). Both changes move the candidate distribution away from the original mixture, and SOL increases accordingly in both directions, see Figure 5 (middle).

In both cases, stronger corruption leads to a larger SOL value, see Figure 5 (right) and Figure 11 . Further corruption experiments are given in Appendix D.6 . blocks.en:
We follow the human-evaluation setup of MAUVE ( Pillutla et al., 2021 ) .
The study compares eight GPT-2 model–decoding configurations using pairwise human judgments of whether continuations are human-like , interesting , and sensible .
For each criterion, the pairwise preferences are converted into system scores by fitting a Bradley–Terry model ( Bradley and Terry, 1952 ) .
We reuse these human judgments and recompute the automatic metrics on fresh samples from the same eight configurations.
We report the worst-case Spearman rank correlation ρ min \rho_{\text{min}} of SOL with the Bradley–Terry scores for different embeddings as well as MAUVE.
Full experimental details are given in Appendix C.4 .

blocks.en:
The comparison in Table 2 serves two purposes. First, we compare SOL and MAUVE using the same GPT-2 Large representation. Under this controlled setting, SOL achieves slightly higher correlation with the human ranking than MAUVE. Second, we investigate whether stronger embedding models further improve SOL. Replacing GPT-2 Large with more recent models leads to substantially higher correlations, indicating that the choice of embedding model has a strong impact on SOL’s agreement with human judgments. Because the original human study displayed at most 256 tokens, we additionally evaluate a sequence length of 256 256 in Table 16 ,
where SOL again outperforms MAUVE.

表2中的比较有两个目的。 首先,我们比较SOL和MAUVE使用相同的GPT-2大型代表. 在这种被控制的设置下,SOL与人类排名的关联性略高于MAUVE. 其次,我们调查更强大的嵌入模型是否进一步改善了SOL. 以较新的模型取代GPT-2大号,导致关联性大幅提高,表明嵌入模型的选择对SOL与人类判断的一致有着强烈的影响. 因为最初的人类研究显示 在最多256个符号, 我们额外评估 序列长度256 256 在表16,

blocks.en: 5.5 Diffusion Language Models on OWT
blocks.zh: 5.5 OWT的传播语言模型

blocks.en:
Diffusion language models, particularly continuous ones, remain difficult to evaluate. ELBO-based perplexities are unavailable for most continuous models, are not comparable across noise processes, and do not distinguish different samplers of the same discrete model. Gen. PPL is also problematic, as it can be improved by reducing the sample entropy ( Franca and Tong, 2026 ) .
Since SOL only requires samples, it applies to all models and samplers alike. We evaluate the discrete diffusion models MDLM ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ) , DUO ( Sahoo et al., 2025 ) , LDDM ( Jo et al., 2026 ) , BD3-LM ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) , ADLM ( Rout et al., 2025 ) and Soft-Masked ( Hersche et al., 2026 ) , and the continuous models vMF and VP ( Chemseddine et al., 2026 ) , LangFlow ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , FLM ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , FMLM ∗ ( Yoo et al., 2026 ) and ELF ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , together with an autoregressive baseline ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ) .
ELF is trained on a corpus that is differently tokenized and compared with its own reference (E). Full experimental details are given in Appendix C.5 .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Current evaluation methods are insufficient for comparing modern language models. We propose SOL, a sample-based distance between text distributions that represents each sequence by the empirical measure of its hidden states and compares the resulting distributions using the double sliced Wasserstein distance.
SOL is a metric for injective reference transformers and admits a stable estimator dominated by a single reference-model forward pass. Unlike Gen. PPL and entropy, SOL detects mode collapse, unlike MAUVE, it is less biased toward the end of the sequence and correlates better with human judgments.
Because SOL only requires samples, it compares autoregressive, discrete, and continuous diffusion models on equal footing. On OpenWebText, we find that better Gen. PPL does not necessarily imply a better fit to the data distribution. We recommend the bidirectional Dream backbone, since it weights all token positions similarly and achieves the strongest overall agreement with human judgments, together with L ξ = L g = 8192 L_{\xi}=L_{g}=8192 slices and 5,000 5{,}000 samples per distribution, at which the estimator stabilizes.
blocks.zh:
目前的评价方法不足以比较现代语言模式。 我们提出SOL,即文本分布之间的一个以样本为基础的距离,以隐藏状态的经验度量来代表每个序列,并用双切出瓦瑟斯坦的距离来比较所产生的分布.
SOL是注射式参考变压器的衡量标准,并承认一个以单一参考模型前传为主的稳定估计器. 与Gen. PPL和Entropy不同,SOL检测到模式崩溃,与MAUVE不同,它对序列末端的偏差较小,更能与人类判断相通.
因为SOL只需要样本,所以它可以同等地比较自递性,离散性,和连续的传播模型. 在OpenWebText上,我们发现更好的Gen. PPL并不一定意味着更适合数据分布. 我们推荐双向"梦想"主干线,因为它同样地权衡所有象征性位置,并与人类判断取得最强有力的总体一致,加上L = L g = 8192 L_{\xi}=L_{g}=8192分片和每分出5000个5{,}000个样本,其中估计器稳定.

blocks.en: The relation between DSW and mean-SW follows directly from the quantile representation of the inner Wasserstein distance. Let μ x \mu_{x} denote the token cloud of a document x x and define its mean by m x := ∫ z ​ d ​ μ x ​ ( z ) . m_{x}:=\int z\,\mathrm{d}\mu_{x}(z). For ξ ∈ 𝕊 d − 1 \xi\in\mathbb{S}^{d-1} , decompose the quantile function of the projected token cloud as Q ξ # ​ μ x ​ ( u ) = ⟨ ξ , m x ⟩ + r ξ , x ​ ( u ) , ∫ 0 1 r ξ , x ​ ( u ) ​ 𝑑 u = 0 . Q_{\xi_{\#}\mu_{x}}(u)=\langle\xi,m_{x}\rangle+r_{\xi,x}(u),\qquad\int_{0}^{1}r_{\xi,x}(u)\,\mathrm{d}u=0. Hence, for a second slicing function g ∈ L 2 ​ ( [ 0 , 1 ] ) g\in L_{2}([0,1]) , the corresponding DSW feature satisfies M ξ , g ​ ( μ x ) := ⟨ Q ξ # ​ μ x , g ⟩ L 2 = a g ​ ⟨ ξ , m x ⟩ + ⟨ r ξ , x , g ⟩ L 2 , a g := ∫ 0 1 g ⁡ ( u ) ​ 𝑑 u . M_{\xi,g}(\mu_{x}):=\bigl\langle Q_{\xi_{\#}\mu_{x}},g\bigr\rangle_{L_{2}}=a_{g}\langle\xi,m_{x}\rangle+\langle r_{\xi,x},g\rangle_{L_{2}},\qquad a_{g}:=\int_{0}^{1}g(u)\,\mathrm{d}u. The first term depends only on the centroid of the token cloud, whereas the second term captures its centered projected shape.

blocks.en: In particular, for the constant function g ≡ 1 g\equiv 1 , M ξ , 1 ​ ( μ x ) = ⟨ ξ , m x ⟩ , M_{\xi,1}(\mu_{x})=\langle\xi,m_{x}\rangle, so restricting the second slicing stage to constant functions recovers mean-SW, up to the chosen normalization. Conversely, if two token clouds satisfy m x = m y m_{x}=m_{y} , mean-SW cannot distinguish them, while M ξ , g ​ ( μ x ) − M ξ , g ​ ( μ y ) = ⟨ r ξ , x − r ξ , y , g ⟩ L 2 M_{\xi,g}(\mu_{x})-M_{\xi,g}(\mu_{y})=\langle r_{\xi,x}-r_{\xi,y},g\rangle_{L_{2}} can be nonzero. Thus, DSW adds information precisely through nonconstant test functions that detect differences in the projected quantile shapes. blocks.en: B.2 Overview of Related Work
blocks.zh: B.2 有关工作概览

blocks.en: B.2.1 Comparing Text Representations via Latent Geometries
blocks.zh: B.2.1 通过Latent Geometries比较文本表述

blocks.en:
Classical bag-of-words representations describe a document through its token
frequencies ( Kusner et al., 2015 ) . Modern transformers instead provide
context-dependent representations. In a causal transformer, the final hidden
state depends on the complete preceding sequence and can, under suitable
assumptions, even uniquely determine it ( Nikolaou et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, dedicated
text encoders such as BGE, GTE, and E5 ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) are primarily optimized by contrastive objectives for semantic similarity,
retrieval, or classification and commonly compress a text into a single dense
vector. This is advantageous for semantic retrieval but less suited to our
goal of detecting arbitrary distributional changes: such representations are
designed to be invariant to semantically minor variations and necessarily
discard part of the token-level distributional structure. In contrast, we use
the complete collection of contextual states of a causal or bidirectional encoder.

blocks.en:
Reference-based metrics such as BERTScore ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) and
MoverScore ( Zhao et al., 2019 ) compare individual generated texts with
paired references using contextual token similarities or optimal transport,
and therefore do not directly measure the fit between two unpaired text
distributions. Distributional metrics address this explicitly.
Fréchet BERT Distance (FBD) ( Alihosseini et al., 2019 ; Xiang et al., 2021 ) fits Gaussian distributions
to pretrained text representations and compares them by the Fréchet
distance. This restricts the comparison to first and second moments and
inherits the statistical difficulties of estimating high-dimensional
covariances. Indeed, the analogous FID estimator in vision is known to be
finite-sample biased and typically requires large sample sizes ( Heusel et al., 2017 ; Chong and Forsyth, 2020 ; Berthet et al., 2026 ) .
PRD ( Sajjadi et al., 2018 ; Xiang et al., 2021 ) separates quality and
coverage, but its practical estimator quantizes the latent distributions by K K -means. MAUVE ( Pillutla et al., 2021 ; Pillutla et al., 2023 ) similarly
quantizes pretrained language-model representations before comparing them
through divergence frontiers, introducing dependence on both sample and
cluster size. Moreover, its standard last-token representation can be
insensitive to perturbations earlier in the sequence ( He et al., 2023 ) . Finally, Gen. PPL and token entropy are
sequence-wise averages rather than discrepancies between distributions and
can remain favorable even under complete corpus-level mode collapse.

blocks.en: B.2.2 Optimal Transport
blocks.zh: B.2.2 最佳运输

blocks.en: Previous work has been done on evaluating text via optimal transport. The Word Mover’s Distance (WMD) ( Kusner et al., 2015 ) represents each document as a bag of pretrained word embeddings and compares two documents by optimal transport between their words. Hierarchical Optimal Topic Transport (HOTT) ( Yurochkin et al., 2019 ) is closer in spirit to our approach: documents are distributions over LDA topics, themselves distributions over words, and are compared by OT on the topic space with WMD as ground distance. Our goal is different: we compare distributions of documents for generative-model evaluation, represent each document directly by its distribution of contextual transformer states rather than static word embeddings or learned topics, and use Double Sliced Wasserstein to avoid solving the resulting nested OT problem directly. Thus, while HOTT introduces a closely related hierarchical representation, our hierarchy operates at the corpus level and exploits contextual sequence representations together with slicing for efficient computation.
blocks.zh: 过去的工作是通过最佳运输方式评估文本。 Word Morrer's District(MW) (Kusner等, 2015年) 代表每个文件, 分级优化主题运输(HOTT)(Yurochkin等,2019年)在精神上更接近于我们的方法:文件是在LDA主题上的分布,本身在文字上的分布,由OT在主题空间上以地相距离为大规模杀伤性武器作比较. 我们的目标不同:我们比较了基因模型评价文件的分布,通过对上下文变压器状态的分布来直接代表每个文件,而不是静态的单词嵌入或被学习的话题,并且使用"双切分"(Double Sliced Wasserstein)来避免直接解决由此产生的嵌入式OT问题. 因此,虽然HOTT引入了一种紧密相联的分级代表制,但我们的分级在实体一级运作,并利用背景序列代表制以及切分法来进行高效计算。

blocks.en:
A related line of work compares entire datasets by optimal transport. OTDD ( Alvarez-Melis and Fusi, 2020 ) represents each label by its
class-conditional feature distribution and uses the Wasserstein distance
between these distributions inside an outer OT problem. To reduce the cost of
the inner transports, the practical Bures-OTDD variant approximates each
class-conditional distribution by a Gaussian, yielding closed-form W 2 W_{2} distances between labels. More recently, s-OTDD ( Nguyen et al., 2025 ) replaces this nested computation by a sliced
construction based on one-dimensional projections. Unlike the moment-based Gaussian approximation in Bures-OTDD, DSW retains the full class-conditional distributions and has been observed to yield stronger agreement with exact nested transport distances. Note that DSW avoids such moment approximations and produces a stronger correlation with the exact nested transport distance than both Gaussian OTDD and s-OTDD ( Piening and Beinert, 2026b ) .

More generally, several works develop tractable approximations for
Wasserstein-type distances between distributions of distributions. For
Gaussian mixtures, slicing has been developed from different geometric
viewpoints ( Piening and Beinert, 2025 ; Nguyen and Mueller, 2026 ; Bonet et al., 2026 ) . Piening et al. (2026) further study sliced and linearized

while Bonet et al. (2025) combine
Wasserstein-over-Wasserstein geometry with tractable MMD objectives based on
Sliced-Wasserstein kernels.
Applications of hierarchical optimal transport beyond text and dataset comparison include stereo vision ( Clerc et al., 2026 ) , graph comparison ( Piening and Beinert, 2026a ) and generative modeling in imaging ( Dukler et al., 2019 ; Geuter et al., 2025 ) and biology ( Yachimura et al., 2024 ; Haviv et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en:
We evaluate SOL using several frozen transformer backbones.
GPT-2 Large Radford et al. (2019) is our default encoder and also

Block discrete denoising diffusion language models generate blocks

KV caching, and generation batch size one. First-hitting updates
unmask one token at a time and stop when the current block is complete; T = 5000 T=5000 is therefore not 5,000 evaluations per block.
The implementation additionally makes a model call to store the KV
cache after completing each block. We retain the release’s rejection
rule: after the generated prefix exceeds 256 tokens, reject an attempt
if the unigram entropy of its last 256 tokens is below 4 4 nats, then
retry. Thus, total generation cost also includes rejected attempts.
There is no separate final decoder call. These checkpoints use
reference family B, which retains document EOT separators but omits
artificial special tokens at the boundaries of training chunks.

blocks.en: D.3 Gaussian Process Bandwidth
blocks.zh: D.3 高斯进程带宽

blocks.en: The RBF length scale λ \lambda controls the smoothness of the second-level slicing functions. For fixed grid resolution M M , small λ \lambda approaches independent Gaussian noise across quantile bins, whereas large λ \lambda approaches a constant function and hence mean-SW. For M = 64 M=64 and λ = 0.01 \lambda=0.01 , adjacent bins have correlation 0.30 0.30 , which already drops to 0.008 0.008 at a separation of two bins. blocks.en: We further investigate whether the response of DSW to textual perturbations is specific to a particular language-model representation. To this end, we repeat the corruption experiment using four substantially different backbone models: GPT-2-large, Qwen3-0.6B-Base, OLMo-2-1B, and Dream-v0-Base-7B. For all encoders, we use the same split of OpenWebText consisting of 5,000 5{,}000 clean reference documents and 5,000 5{,}000 disjoint candidate documents. Thus, differences between the resulting curves arise from the representation induced by the encoder rather than from different underlying documents.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步调查世界人口基金会对文字扰动的反应是否针对特定语言模式。 为此,我们使用四个截然不同的骨干模型重复了腐败实验:GPT-2-大,Quen3-0.6B-Base,OLMo-2-1B和Dream-v0-Base-7B. 对所有编码器,我们使用OpenWebText的同分法,由5000个5{,}000个干净的参考文件和5000个5{,}000个脱节的候选文件组成. 因此,由此产生的曲线之间的差异来自编码器引起的表述,而不是不同的基础文件。

blocks.en: We consider two types of corruption. For the insertion experiment, literal [CLS] strings are inserted at randomly chosen whitespace-word boundaries, where the corruption rate denotes the number of insertions relative to the original number of words. For the shuffle experiment, the prescribed fraction of whitespace-word positions is selected and the corresponding words are randomly permuted. Hence, shuffling preserves the word multiset while increasingly disrupting local and global word order. In both cases, we use corruption rates 0 % , 1 % , 2 % , 5 % , 10 % , 20 % , 50 % , 100 % . 0\%,\,1\%,\,2\%,\,5\%,\,10\%,\,20\%,\,50\%,\,100\%.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑两种类型的腐败。 对于插入实验,在随机选择的白空字符边界上插入字面[CLS]字符串,其中腐败率表示相对于原字数的插入数. 对于洗牌实验,选择了所指定的部分白空字位置,并随机地将相应的单词穿插. 因此,打乱保留了多集字,同时越来越多地扰乱了当地和全球的字序。 在这两种情况下,我们使用腐败率0%,1%,2%,5%,10%,20%,50%,100%。 0\%,相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相

blocks.en: Importantly, the corruption is applied to the raw text before tokenization. Each corrupted document is subsequently processed using the respective model’s own tokenizer and truncated to a horizon of 256 256 tokens. We construct the token cloud from the final hidden-state representations without pooling. Consequently, the textual corruption is identical across backbones, whereas differences induced by tokenization, hidden dimension, and truncation remain part of the encoder comparison.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,腐败先适用于原始文本,然后才作象征性说明。 每份被损坏的文件随后都使用各自模型的代号器处理,并缩短到256 256个代号的地平线。 我们从最后隐藏状态的表述中 构筑出象征的云 因此,各骨干体的文字腐败是相同的,而由象征性、隐形和截断引起的差异仍然是编码器比较的一部分。

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 12 , the text encoders are
substantially less sensitive to small perturbations than GPT-2 Large.
For example, at only 1 % 1\% word shuffling, DSW 2 increases by a factor
of 1.459 1.459 over the clean–clean floor for GPT-2 Large, compared with
only 1.022 1.022 , 1.064 1.064 , and 1.026 1.026 for GTE, E5, and BGE, respectively.
Thus, the text encoders do detect sufficiently strong corruption, but
resolve small local perturbations much less clearly. This is undesirable
for our purpose, since differences in the underlying text distribution
should already be reflected at low corruption rates. A useful distributional metric should therefore respond at low corruption rates without saturating at high ones. The text encoders fail the first requirement, while mean-pooled MAUVE fails the second (Appendix E.2.1 ).

blocks.en: MAUVE can also be computed on the mean-pooled representation equation 5 instead of the last-token representation equation 4 , as in Franca and Tong (2026) . With mean pooling, however, the score saturates quickly under corruption (Table 17 ). Under [CLS] pollution, MAUVE drops from 0.97 to 0.47 at 5% and to 0.06 at 10%, after which it stays near zero (0.018 at 20%, 0.012 at 100%). Word shuffling shows the same pattern between 10% and 20%. Responding to small corruption is desirable in itself. The problem is that the score has used up its range by 10%, so it cannot distinguish 10% from 100% corrupted text. Once the two samples fall into largely disjoint clusters, the divergence frontier collapses and MAUVE stays at its floor however much worse the text becomes. With the last-token representation, MAUVE degrades more gradually (Table 9 ), but it is insensitive to where in the sequence the corruption occurs (Figure 3 ). SOL increases monotonically over the full range of corruption rates (Figure 11 ).
blocks.zh: MAUVE也可以根据平均组合代表方程式5而不是最后组合代表方程式4计算,如Franca和Tong(2026年). 然而,在腐败下,得分迅速饱和(表17)。 在[CLS]污染下,MAUVE从0.97降至0.47,以5%降至0.06,以10%降至0.06,之后保持接近于零(0.018为20%,0.012为100%)。 单词打字显示在10%到20%之间的模式相同. 应对小的腐败本身是可取的。 问题在于分数用完了10%的幅度,因此无法区分10%和100%被破坏的文字. 一旦两个样本分解成基本上不相连的组群,分歧的边界就会崩溃,不管文本变得更糟,MAUVE都会留在它的地上。 由于最后一种说法,MAUVE更逐渐地退化(表9),但对腐败发生地点不敏感(图3)。 SOL在各种腐败率上单调地上升(图11)。

blocks.en: We evaluated 25,000 samples generated by the vMF model from ( Chemseddine et al., 2026 ) using 64 predictor steps and one Langevin corrector step per predictor step, corresponding to 128 function evaluations. We constructed 25,000 reference sequences from the held-out LM1B test split using the model’s BERT tokenizer and 128-token packing scheme, while retaining the same special-token formatting in both corpora. We extracted GPT-2-large features in FP32 from the final hidden state at the last non-padding token, using a maximum sequence length of 256 tokens.

blocks.en: E.2.3 Comparing MAUVE with SOL
blocks.zh: E.2.3 将 " 任务 " 与 " 任务 " 相比较

blocks.en: We recap the different drawbacks with the use of the MAUVE score. Throughout the paper, we have seen the affects of different design choices on MAUVE.
blocks.zh: 我们回顾使用MAUVE分数的不同缺点。 在整个论文中,我们看到了不同设计选择对MAUVE的影响.

blocks.en:
MAUVE appears to be heavily dependent on the number of clusters chosen.
As shown in Figure 2 , keeping a fixed ratio of clusters to samples decreases the MAUVE score as the sample size increases.
In contrast when comparing true data in Figure 13 , keeping the number of clusters fixed while increasing the number of samples causes the score to converge to 1. This raises the question of which score to report and makes it hard to compare MAUVE scores. SOL, however, converges as we increase the number of samples (GPT-2 Large: Figure 7 , Dream: Figure 9 ), the number of slices (GPT-2 Large: Figure 6 , Dream: Figure 8 ), or the number of integration points (Figure 10 ). SOL is therefore numerically much more stable.
blocks.zh:
MAUVE似乎严重依赖所选择的集群数量.
如图2所显示的,保留一个固定的集群与样本的比例,随着样本大小的增加会减少MAUVE分数.
相比之下,在比较图13中的真实数据时,在增加样本数量的同时,保留整数组数会导致分数趋同为一. 这就提出了要报告哪个分数的问题,也使得MAUVE分数难以比较. 然而,当我们增加样品数量(GPT-2大:图7,梦想:图9),切片数量(GPT-2大:图6,梦想:图8),或集成点数量(图10)时,SOL会趋同. 因此,SOL在数字上要稳定得多。

blocks.en: Figure 13: For two disjoint LM1B corpora, the reported MAUVE score depends on the number of evaluation samples n n and clusters K K . In comparison to generated vs true data the ratio n / 10 = K n/10=K is stable, but increasing n n converges to 1.

blocks.en: In particular, inexpensive SOL estimates based on only a few samples and slices already provide relatively reliable approximations to the full evaluation, making them suitable for monitoring during training.
blocks.zh: 特别是,仅根据少数样本和切片得出的低廉的SOL估计数已经为全面评价提供了相对可靠的近似值,使其适合在培训期间进行监测。

blocks.en:
MAUVE with the
(standard) last-token hidden representation has a strong bias towards the end of a sequence. As shown in Figure 2 , replacing the beginning with random tokens has little effect on the score. This is also visible in Section E.3.1 (Diffusion Language Model comparison), where the collapse of the last-token entropy leads to a significantly worse MAUVE score, even when the middle remains comparable. With a mean-pooled representation , repeating tokens 10% of the time produces a MAUVE score of almost 0, indicating a very poor match, see Table 17 . For the last-token hidden representation, the same test yields a MAUVE score of 0 at repetition rates above 50 % 50\% (Table 9 ). In the same experiment, SOL shows an almost linear degradation (Figure 11 ).
blocks.zh:
与我们一起

blocks.en: We use the human evaluation experiment from Pillutla et al. (2021) , see Section C.4 . At sequence lengths of 256 and 1024 tokens (Tables 16 and 2 ), SOL outperforms MAUVE for almost all embedding models. This indicates that SOL correlates better with human judgments than MAUVE.

To test whether the final-token distribution drives MAUVE, we reweight the generated documents by their last token. Overrepresented final tokens get less weight, underrepresented ones get more. This makes the weighted final-token frequencies match real OWT without changing the texts.
After this correction, MAUVE rises from 0.492 0.492 to 0.591 0.591 for greedy DUO, but only from 0.836 0.836 to 0.843 0.843 for ancestral DUO. SOL changes by only 0.29 % 0.29\% and 0.07 % 0.07\% , respectively. This shows that MAUVE is much more sensitive to the final-token distribution than SOL.
blocks.zh:
为了测试最终的磁盘发行是否驱动了MAUVE,我们将生成的文档以最后的符号重新加权. 任职人数过多的最终标志的重量减少,任职人数不足的标志的重量增加。 这使得加权最终调取的频率在不更改文本的情况下与实际的OTW相匹配.
经过这次更正后,MAUVE因贪婪而从0.492 0.492上升到了0.591 0.591,但因祖传DUO而从0.836 0.836上升到了0.843 0.843. SOL分别仅变化了0.29%.0.29\%和0.07%.07\%. 这表明了MAUVE对最终的托肯发行的敏感度远高于SOL.

blocks.en:
For the implementation of our reweighting, we group documents by their final token. We treat each final-token ID that appears at least five times in both corpora as a separate category. All remaining tokens are pooled into an “other” category.

We then recompute MAUVE with weighted generated-cluster counts and the original reference histogram. This changes only the document weights, not the texts.

blocks.en: E.3.2 Precision, Recall, and Coverage
blocks.zh: E.3.2 精确、回顾和覆盖范围

blocks.en:
We complement SOL with the embedding-based precision and recall evaluation of Bronnec et al. (2024) and coverage from Naeem et al. (2020) .
We compare MDLM and ReMDM-loop using the same Soft-Masked checkpoint,
1,024-token generations, T = 1024 T=1024 , final noise removal, and p = 0.9 p=0.9 .
For each of three independent repetitions, we generate 5,000 samples per
sampler and draw disjoint sets of 10,000 calibration and 5,000 reference
examples from held-out OpenWebText. Within each repetition, both samplers
are evaluated against the same reference set and under the same embedding
transformation, yielding a paired comparison.
blocks.zh:
我们通过对Bronnec等人(2024年)的嵌入精度和召回评价以及Naeem等人(2020年)的覆盖面来补充SOL。
我们用同样的软磁盘检查点来比较MDLM和RemDM-loop,
1 024-token一代,T=1024 T=1024,最终去除噪声;p=0.9 p=0.9.
每三次独立重复,我们产生5 000个样本
取样和绘制10 000个校准和5 000个参考的脱节相机
来自被搁置的 OpenWebText 的实例。 在每次重复中,两个取样员
在同一套参考物和嵌入物下评价
转换,产生一对比较。

blocks.en:
We use GPT-2-large final-layer last-token embeddings, L2 normalization,
unwhitened PCA, and Euclidean distances. Whereas Bronnec et al. (2024) fit PCA jointly to reference and
generated samples and retain 90% of the variance, we fit PCA exclusively
on the independent real calibration set. We fix the representation to
350 dimensions, corresponding to 89.32–89.52% explained variance across
the three calibration sets. This avoids adapting the representation to
either sampler.

无论是采样者。

blocks.en:
For k = 4 k=4 , the radius associated with each point is its distance to its
fourth nearest neighbor within the same corpus. Precision is the fraction
of generated samples contained in the union of reference neighborhoods,
whereas recall is the fraction of reference samples contained in the union
of generated neighborhoods. Coverage is the fraction of reference points
whose reference-defined neighborhood contains at least one generated
sample ( Naeem et al., 2020 ) . Thus recall depends on generated-sample
neighborhood radii, while coverage uses only reference-sample radii.

blocks.en: The vMF comparison provides direct evidence for the benefit of self-conditioning. At the same 128-step predictor–corrector setting, the base self-conditioned model improves Dream SOL from 45.900 45.900 to 31.379 31.379 and Gen. PPL from 141.9 141.9 to 45.1 45.1 . This improvement is not explained by entropy matching, which changes from 5.533 5.533 to 5.315 5.315 and therefore moves slightly farther from the data entropy. The distilled ELF* model still exhibits a gap to ELF-B, although this comparison does not isolate self-conditioning from other model and training differences.

blocks.en: Soft-Masked with ReMDM-loop improves over the AR baseline on all three SOL encoders, from ( 1.064 , 7.450 , 22.207 ) (1.064,7.450,22.207) to ( 0.6101 , 3.526 , 18.966 ) (0.6101,3.526,18.966) . blocks.en: Gen. PPL and entropy should be interpreted jointly: Gen. PPL should be small, while entropy should remain close to that of the data. Even together, however, they do not determine distributional quality. For distilled DUO, ancestral and greedy-tail sampling have almost identical entropy deviations from the data ( | 5.518 − 5.449 | = 0.069 |5.518-5.449|=0.069 and | 5.378 − 5.449 | = 0.071 |5.378-5.449|=0.071 ). Greedy-tail sampling nevertheless lowers Gen. PPL substantially, from 62.3 62.3 to 46.5 46.5 , while worsening SOL on all three encoders, including Dream from 30.595 30.595 to 31.802 31.802 . More strongly, exact MDLM has both lower Gen. PPL than VP with ODE sampling ( 59.4 59.4 versus 66.1 66.1 ) and entropy closer to the data ( 5.445 5.445 versus 5.435 5.435 ), yet has worse SOL on all three encoders: ( 2.185 , 14.119 , 36.394 ) (2.185,14.119,36.394) versus ( 1.775 , 11.997 , 33.275 ) (1.775,11.997,33.275) . Thus, even favorable Gen. PPL and entropy do not guarantee a better match to the text distribution.

blocks.en: E.4 Additional Sampler
blocks.zh: E.4 其他抽样

blocks.en:
We investigate how sampling strategies affect GPT-2-XL’s agreement with
the WebText distribution. We compare ancestral sampling, which draws
directly from the model’s next-token distribution, and nucleus sampling
with p = 0.95 p=0.95 ( Holtzman et al., 2020 ) , which restricts sampling to the
smallest set of highest-probability tokens with cumulative probability
at least p p , renormalizing their probabilities. We also evaluate
greedy decoding, which deterministically selects the most likely token,
in the conditional setting.

blocks.en: Algorithm 2 Numerical approximation of SOL
blocks.zh: SOL 的数值近似值

blocks.en:
The reference transformer is evaluated in batches.
Hidden states are cast to FP32 before projection.
Token projections, bin-average computation, second-level projections,
sorting, and Wasserstein reductions are performed in FP32.
The Gaussian-process covariance and Cholesky factorization are computed
in FP64, after which the sampled GP values are cast to FP32.
blocks.zh:
参考变压器分批评估.
隐藏状态在投影前投出至FP32.
预测、本平均计算、二级预测、
分拣,Wasserstein在FP32中进行削减。
高斯进程共变和Cholesky因子化是计算出来的
在FP64中,然后将所抽样的GP值投放到FP32中。

blocks.en:
For each first-level projection seed, the bin-average tensors of shape n × L ξ × M n\times L_{\xi}\times M are stored as FP32 memory-mapped arrays.
The second-level computation is performed in blocks of first-level
directions and reuses the reference tensors across generated corpora.
Thus neither all n ​ L ξ ​ L g nL_{\xi}L_{g} document scalars nor a pairwise document
cost matrix need to be stored simultaneously.
Changing only the GP seed requires no additional transformer evaluation.
